jobs.title: Azure Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**Role: Sr. Azure Data Engineer with Databricks**

**Experience: -** Min 8+ Years

**Location: -** Chicago, IL (Hybrid 3 days' Work from Office)

Seeking a **Senior Data Engineer** with deep expertise in SQL Server, Azure SQL, and Databricks to design, optimize, and deliver scalable cloud-based data solutions supporting analytics and enterprise data platforms

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Database Development & Optimization:** Design, develop, and maintain complex **SQL Server and Azure SQL** databases.

Write and optimize advanced **T-SQL** queries, stored procedures, functions, and views.

Perform **query tuning, indexing strategies, and performance optimization** for large-scale datasets.

Implement best practices for **database security, data integrity, and reliability**.

**Cloud & Data Platform**: Develop and manage data solutions in **Azure SQL Database**.

Work with **Databricks (Apache Spark)** to support data transformations, analytics, and largescale data processing.

Integrate Azure SQL with Databricks using **Delta Lake, Spark SQL, and PySpark/SQL** where applicable.

Support cloud-based data architectures and hybrid data environments.

**Data Modelling & Warehousing:** Design and maintain **relational and dimensional data models**.

Implement **Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)** and other data warehousing patterns.

Support ETL/ELT processes and collaborate with data engineering teams.

**Collaboration & Leadership:** Partner with application developers, data engineers, BI teams, and stakeholders to understand data requirements.

Provide guidance and mentoring to junior developers.

Participate in code reviews and enforce database development standards.

Troubleshoot production issues and provide root cause analysis.

**Educational Qualifications: -**

Engineering Degree BE/ME/BTech/MTech/BSc/MSc.

Technical certification in multiple technologies is desirable.

**Skills: -**

Mandatory skills

min 8**+ years** of experience as a Database Developer or similar role.

Strong expertise in **SQL Server and Azure SQL**.

Advanced proficiency in **T-SQL**, including performance tuning and query optimization.

Hands-on experience with **Databricks** and **Apache Spark**.

Solid understanding of **data warehousing concepts**, dimensional modelling, and SCD.

Experience working in **Azure cloud environments**.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Client Interview can happen Virtual but candidate needs to relocate to Chicago, IL from day 1.**

jobs.title: ETL QA -Databricks
jobs.description:
**Role: ETL QA -Databricks**

We are looking for a Senior ETL QA Engineer with strong experience in ETL testing, SQL, data validation, and Azure Databricks. The candidate will be responsible for validating complex data pipelines, ensuring data accuracy and integrity, and developing scalable testing strategies for enterprise data platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and execute comprehensive test strategies for ETL and data integration processes.
* Perform end to end ETL testing across source, transformation, and target systems.
* Develop complex SQL queries for data validation, reconciliation, and data quality testing.
* Validate data transformations, mappings, business rules, and data pipelines.
* Perform testing of data pipelines and workflows implemented in Azure Databricks.
* Validate data processing and transformations within Databricks environments.
* Identify data discrepancies, perform root cause analysis, and work closely with development and data engineering teams to resolve issues.
* Validate data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and integrity across multiple systems.
* Create and maintain detailed test cases, test scenarios, test scripts, and test execution reports.
* Perform regression, integration, system, and end to end testing.
* Support data quality initiatives and establish scalable validation processes.
* Analyze testing results and provide clear reporting on defects, risks, and data quality issues.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers, Developers, Business Analysts, and other QA professionals.
* **Required Skills**
* 8+ years of experience in QA and ETL testing.
* Strong hands on experience with ETL testing and data validation.
* Advanced SQL skills.
* Strong experience with Azure Databricks.
* Experience testing data pipelines and data transformations.
* Strong understanding of data warehousing and ETL concepts.
* Experience with data reconciliation and data quality validation.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
* Experience with defect management and test management processes.
* **Preferred Skills**
* Experience with automated data testing or data automation tools.
* Experience working in Agile environments.
* Healthcare or financial domain experience is a plus.
* Candidate Requirements
* Must be local to Chicago, IL.
* Face to Face interview is required

jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist, Global Patents
jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short-Term Disability + Baby Bonding): 28-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year

  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Seattle, WA, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; Washington D.C., DC, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Engineering, Sciences, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience working with patent data in a corporate or law firm environment.
* 7 years of experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis.
* Experience working with a national patent offices or academic institutions studying patent strategy, policy, and innovation economics using data science and AI.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 9 years of experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis.
* 9 years of experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP), Large Language Models (LLMs), semantic search, or knowledge graph extraction.
* 9 years of experience working specifically with legal, technical, or patent datasets, including familiarity with patent taxonomies, citation networks, and prior art search methodologies.

**About the job**
-----------------

Help serve Google's worldwide user base of more than a billion people. Data Scientists provide quantitative support, market understanding and a strategic perspective to our partners throughout the organization. As a data-loving member of the team, you serve as an analytics expert for your partners, using numbers to help them make better decisions. You will weave stories with meaningful insight from data. You'll make critical recommendations for your fellow Googlers in Engineering and Product Management. You relish tallying up the numbers one minute and communicating your findings to a team leader the next.
  
  
Google’s Global Patents Team is an inspiring team of innovators and attorneys who are passionate about future technologies and excited about resolving their ensuing legal challenges. As a member of this team, you will have the unique opportunity to develop and implement Google's strategy to protect, defend and capture the value of Google’s technological innovation. You will dive into varied and interesting tasks that include patent-related protection, licensing, dispute resolution, acquisition, deals and policy work.
  
  
As a Senior Global Patents Data Scientist, you will be focusing on applied data and AI solution creations and experimentations. You will use a variety of tools and languages to make sense of large amounts of patent data, one of largest legal data corpus in history, generate AI enabled patent-specific applications, contribute to novel statistical and machine learning models, work closely with subject matter experts and stakeholders to constantly search for ways to make existing workflows and processes more efficient with AI.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive the implementation of patent AI transformation initiatives focusing on patent prosecution and patent transaction use cases.
* Apply patent and AI expertise to support patent engagement with the academic community and various patent offices on empirical patent and innovation studies and advise on AI implementations.
* Work with public patent data, internal data and tool stack to create custom AI solutions to support patent portfolio strategy, development, quality reviews and other patent workflows.
* Leverage patent expertise to develop internal patent transactions specific solutions to review third-party patent and licensing inquiries.
* Collaborate with outside counsel, internal legal team members, dedicated patent specialist vendors to achieve scaled impact.

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.
